verdict_note: set by emit.close(verdict=...); a verdict that exists only as prose in case.md cannot be read back reliably

reading.items_in_corpus_note: in-window items only; the corpus header's headline additionally counts [CONTEXT] items

gate.rule: branch B when items_in_window > threshold; slices are whole threads in corpus order, at most budget_items in-window items each, a larger thread a slice by itself, a slice under floor_items folded into its neighbour
